title: fix(plugin-approvals)!: refuse a reassign target that resolves to no one
body:
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuMdu6odAshaFZ1Ujr7q9LcW)_ Fixes #25485 Clause-②: no (narrowing) Metadata-protocol: none ## What changed `ApprovalService.reassign` now resolves `to` before it writes anything. A target that resolves to no one is refused with `VALIDATION_FAILED`, which the route already answers as `400`, and the message names the address. The slate, the approver index, the audit trail and the notifications are left as they were. | `to` | Before | After | |---|---|---| | a user id with a `sys_user` row, member here or with no membership rows | moves the slot | moves the slot | | a user id with no `sys_user` row (`usr_does_not_exist`, `nobody-at-all`) | **200, request stranded** | `400`: names no user in this request's organization | | a user whose memberships are all in other organizations | **200** | `400`, same words as a missing user | | an email an account carries (as stored) | moves the slot | moves the slot | | an email no account carries | **200** | `400` | | `position:

` with a holder in the request's organization | moves the slot | moves the slot | | `position:

` that no one holds here | **200** | `400`: no one holds position `p` here | | `team:` / `department:` / `org_membership_level:` / a stored `role:` | **200** | `400`: a slot literal no approver acts under | - **Where the check sits.** It runs after the authorization branches, so a caller who may not move the slot still gets `403 FORBIDDEN` and no directory read is made for the target. A pin asserts that no read names the target. The ordering ablation (check moved above the authorization) turns that pin red. - **The organization screen** is the posture the manager and team expansions already use on `sys_member` (`managerIsProvablyOutsideOrg`, `dropMembersProvablyOutsideOrg`). Membership rows that name only other organizations mean refuse. No membership rows, or an unreadable `sys_member`, means there is no tenancy fact, and the target stands. A request with no organization skips the screen. - **No probe of other tenants.** A missing user and a user of another organization get one refusal text. - **A failed `sys_user` read propagates**, so the caller is told and nothing moves. - **Positions** resolve through `expandPositionUsers`, the routing read a position approver opens on. `approver-address.ts` gains `addressedPosition(address)`, the inverse of `positionAddresses`, so the `position:` prefix stays in the one module that owns it. The module is not exported from the package entry. - **The admin rescue** (`isOverride` with no slot held) is held to the same rule. The override admits the caller; it does not exempt the new slot. - **No new error code.** `VALIDATION_FAILED` is already this door's refusal (an empty `to` and an already-pending `to` use it). `packages/rest` is untouched. The changeset (`patch`, `**BREAKING**` banner, `(narrowing)` arm, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`) gives the FROM → TO and what a caller does. ## Tests - `approval-service.test.ts` gains `reassign target resolution (#25485)`, 10 cases. Each refusal asserts the named message, the slate and the approver index unchanged, no `reassign` action row, and no `approval.reassigned` notice: - the card's two measurements: holder → `nobody-at-all`, platform admin → `usr_does_not_exist`; - the admin rescue of a `position:ghost` slate onto an unknown id; - an email no account carries; - a user whose only membership is another organization, with the same text as a missing user; - a position held only in another organization; - four `type:value` literals; - the FORBIDDEN-first ordering (no read names the target). - Preservation: a member here and a user with no membership rows; an email in its stored spelling; a held `position:finance`, whose holder then decides the request with the default actor. - New `packages/qa/dogfood/test/approval-reassign-target-resolves.dogfood.test.ts` drives the real REST door on a booted stack, reusing the #22824 fixture's staffed object. The holder (unknown id, bare word, `team:` literal) and the platform admin each get `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` naming the address. The slate is unchanged and no `reassign` row exists. Then a reassign to a member of the organization answers 200, and the member's "My Pending" lists the request. Fixtures that reassigned to an id with no account now give it one: - `approval-service.test.ts`: a `staffDirectory(engine, …ids)` helper, called in the 11 tests that hand a slot to `u7`, `u_next` or `u_holder`. - `admin-exemption-retired.test.ts` and `approval-override-audit.test.ts`: their `beforeEach` seeds `sys_user` `u7`. - `actor-lookups-hold-ids.integration.test.ts`: registers a minimal `sys_user_position` and gives `position:finance` a holder (`u_boss`), so the ruling's "email handed to a position" hand-off still runs. ## Verification - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run`: 95 files, 1244 tests, all passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals typecheck` passed, `check:test-typecheck` included (the ledger held at 324). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck` passed. eslint on the 7 changed source and test files: clean. - Ablation, with `approval-service.ts` restored from `origin/main`: - The 6 refusal pins in the new block went red. The 4 preservation pins stayed green, as expected: the old code already moved a slot to a valid target. - The dogfood pin went red on its first refusal (`expected 200 to be 400`), after a rebuild of the plugin's `dist`. - Ordering ablation, with the check moved above the authorization branches: the FORBIDDEN-first pin went red. - After each restore the file matched HEAD and `git status --porcelain` was empty. - Local gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 76 families): 74 exited 0 on the first pass. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 on missing prerequisites (the shallow clone's pinned fixture commit, 7 dists). Both exited 0 once the fixture commit was fetched and the dists were built. `--ran` reconcile: 76 derived, 76 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. - `main` merged at `00d5635ad9`; nothing incoming touches `plugin-approvals`, `rest` or the dogfood package. The full dogfood battery (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm) runs on this head next. Its counts go in the `os-dev-report` on #25485. ## Acceptance notes - The branch is the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-h5z02d`, not `claude/issue-25485-…`. Claim 6378753403 on #25485 is the identity record. - The claim named "a new pin file". The unit pins went into the existing `approval-service.test.ts` instead, beside the reassign tests it already holds, so no new engine double was needed. The new file is the dogfood pin. - Out of scope, same family: the SLA escalation `action: 'reassign'` (`escalateRequest`) falls back to the literal `escalateTo` when its position expansion is empty. A config naming a user id that does not exist, or an unstaffed position, still writes an unresolvable slate on timeout. That target is authored in flow metadata, not sent to a door, so the right fix is at authoring or publish time, not here. Handed to the lane seat to file or cite. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_01HopxxRtFE6z3z91wUD54tp)_ 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_01HopxxRtFE6z3z91wUD54tp
